evaluation_note: PRELIMINARY: not enough real/verified data, so validation/test are drawn from the same (synthetic-dominated) pool. Treat metrics as a pipeline check, not as evidence of real-world accuracy.

splits.evaluation_note: PRELIMINARY: not enough real/verified data, so validation/test are drawn from the same (synthetic-dominated) pool. Treat metrics as a pipeline check, not as evidence of real-world accuracy.

selection_rule: validation split; candidates with FNR <= 0.15 first, then highest PR-AUC (differences < 0.01 are treated as ties), then F2, then CV-F2, then lowest FNR. Accuracy is reported but never used to choose.

calibration.note: Calibrated probabilities are shown only in technical views. Decisions use them only when status == 'validated'; 'preliminary_small_sample' means fewer than 200 validation messages.

per_language_method: predictions of the selected model on the held-out validation + test messages
